body:
Implement slice 4 of docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md: wire the Claude Code plugin as the first **enforcing** harness adapter for context-rot handoff. Slices 1–3 shipped (package + CLI + build-gate isHardDegraded). This ticket does NOT wire Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor/agy/Copilot (slices 5–6) and does NOT add Proven CI (slice 7).

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md and .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md — do not weaken D1–D3 / authorized() / CLI contracts.

=== NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR (Claude Code) ===
1. Resolve a safe `session_id` for the process (from Claude Code hook payload and/or transcript identity). If no usable session id can be derived, fail closed for mutation tools once handoff/hard pressure applies (document the chosen identity source in the hook).
2. On each PreToolUse (and Bash) evaluation for mutation-relevant tools: load deny records via `@adlc/context-handoff` (`loadDenyRecords` / `mutationGateInputFromLoad`) and call `evaluateMutationGate`. If `{deny:true}`, emit Claude Code deny (permissionDecision deny + non-zero exit), matching existing rails/buildgate fail-closed style.
3. When absolute **handoff** band fires (`evaluateBands` / `handoffDenyActive` policy for this slice: handoff or hard on available signals): ensure deny marker for current session (`ensureDenyMarker`), prefer writing/refreshing final via library or `adlc handoff write --write` from the **host** path — never rely on agent Shell under deny.
4. Under deny-set (D1|D2|D3): deny structured edits (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/etc.) AND **Shell/Bash fail-closed-all** (no classifier fork in v1). Also deny agent Shell attempting `adlc handoff` mutating subcommands (write|resume|bypass|repair|unlock).
5. Protect paths from agent Write: `.adlc/handoffs/denies/**`, `.adlc/.deny-store`, `*.resume-auth.json`, `*.model-ok`, `*.lock` under handoffs.
6. Depth/bytes(/pct if available) signals MUST come from `@adlc/context-handoff` thresholds / `isHardDegraded` / `evaluateBands` — no new hard-threshold literals in the CC adapter.
7. Contract tests drive the **real** hook entrypoint (subprocess), covering: open deny blocks Edit+Bash; denier sticky after consume; other-session without resume-auth denied; Shell `adlc handoff repair` denied under deny; no usable session id fail-closed path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- CC plugin depends on / imports `@adlc/context-handoff` for gate evaluation (not a forked D1–D3). verify: `rg -n "evaluateMutationGate|mutationGateInputFromLoad|loadDenyRecords" plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/`
- PreToolUse (or dedicated handoff mode wired in hooks.json) denies Edit when an open deny exists for another session without auth. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs`
- Bash/Shell is denied under active deny-set (fail-closed-all). verify: same test file asserts Bash deny
- Agent Shell invoking `adlc handoff repair|write|bypass` is denied under deny-set. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs`
- Handoff/hard path ensures deny marker for current session id. verify: tests create marker under `.adlc/handoffs/denies/`
- Binding specs untouched and lint clean. verify: `adlc spec-lint docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md` and empty `git diff origin/main -- docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Slice-1/2/3 rails still green. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/{test,cli-test}/*.test.mjs packages/build-gate/test/{depth-signal,hard-band-compat}.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none

Out of scope: Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor/Antigravity/Copilot adapters; Proven CI; Gemini depth-50 align (#473); literal-ban CI (#474); changing HARD_* defaults; host compactors.
title: context-handoff slice 4: Claude Code enforcing deny/handoff adapter
